settings.title: Bundle products into *a community plan*
settings.body:
Include published courses and digital downloads in a community plan. Members get them automatically when their membership becomes active, with no extra checkout.

You choose which plan is shown first on the sales page. Archive an old plan to stop offering it, and the people already on it keep their access.

[See communities](/communities)

settings.title: Know *what you set up*
settings.body:
Your school has one currency, set when you create it, and every price uses it. Once your school has taken a payment, the currency can't be changed.

After you save your keys, CourseLit creates the payment confirmation webhook on your provider account for you, so learners get access straight after they pay.

[Set up payments](/docs/settings/payments)

items.question: Does CourseLit take a percentage of my sales?
items.answer: No. CourseLit charges no fee on your sales on any plan. Your payment provider's own fees still apply.

items.question: Can I sell before connecting a provider?
items.answer: You can create products and use free plans without one. Paid plans need a connected provider.

items.question: Does the currency work with Lemon Squeezy?
items.answer: The currency you choose in CourseLit is not applied at checkout for Lemon Squeezy. Set your currency in your Lemon Squeezy dashboard and match each subscription variant's price.

items.question: What if I reset my payment method?
items.answer: Paid plans of every product fail at checkout until you choose a provider again. Free plans keep working and your saved keys are kept.
